answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 11025 Country: India Title: what is the meaning of ruzain ibrahim Question: what is the meaning of ruzain ibrahim Answer ID: 11025 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 220/168=L/1430) Razin means: sedate and sober, while Ibrahim is the name of the well-known prophet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
